profile.headline: Software Developer at Red Technologies (a division of Spot Freight)
profile.summary:
Software developer (C#, React, EF) with business and technical analysis skills and experience. At Red, have worked on several parts of a whole suite of transportation software under continued development. At CSCI, developed a new MVC 5 application that corrects highway safety data., and includes an ESRI ArcGIS map with drag-and-drop editing capability. Have built console apps and integration apps. Have completed several Udemy courses in CSS and React in 2022.
Specialties: C#, ASP.NET, MVC 4/5, React, T-SQL, JavaScript/AJAX/jQuery, RESTful web services, ArcGIS, Telerik/Kendo UI controls, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Swagger, Postman, CSS Grids and CSS Flexbox. Some Unix experience as well.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•We have a whole suite of transportation software under continued development. C# on the backend (code, API endpoints), MVC, Kendo controls and Razor for some apps, React with hooks on the frontend for the Portal apps, JavaScript/jQuery, ArcGIS, SQL Server stored procedures, .NET Framework and .NET Core; source control with SourceTree, Git, TFS, or Visual Studio source control; Node.js, Yarn.
•I develop shipment route maps with Esri ArcGIS for JavaScript API.
•Day to day, I work off of tickets from the board to make feature additions or changes, bug fixes, and other things to our Red Core site used by our internal shipment dispatchers (it is ASP.NET MVC written in C#, EF, SQL Server database and some stored procedures directly called from the app, Javascript/jQuery.  Also, there is some C# code that handles API calls with our other software apps (including TMS, Trucks, and Driver), and API code to interface with 3rd party-related integrations).
•Customer Portal Team - C#/ASP.NET, .NET Core on the backend (code, API endpoints), React Redux/JavaScript with hooks on the frontend, Esri ArcGIS maps; Azure DevOps. Source control with Git.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: (for CSCI's state government client): Coding in C#, ASP.NET-MVC 5, jQuery, AJAX, KendoUI Controls, ESRI arcGIS, and Oracle 11/12 SQL -  for a new-from-the-ground-up app related to highway traffic safety.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Creation of web apps. Use C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET and JavaScript/JQuery application code for Delivra's messaging software. Customization of Telerik controls
• Revision work on existing software modules, creating and consolidating pages and classes, and applying a new consistent UI to a functionally disparate collection of pages and modules in the software
• Created new ASP.NET/VB.NET Customer Segmentation delete module 
• Created new ASP.NET/C# Contact Info suite (Add/Edit/Import/Dashboard)
• Created new page for Contact searching that relies on Javascript and JQuery for smooth operation
• Participated in daily Scrum meetings
• Built 3 new custom integrations to suit customer needs (including one that interfaces between Eventbrite.com (using OAuth) and our existing customers)
